answer: Each payout must cross a canyon on a single-lane bridge: one claim per funding trail per epoch, and the toll is an orchard season ticket earned by tending a stranger's orchard row for a full epoch of real work, non-transferable and expiring at epoch end. A prism at the gate rotates each epoch and admits only tickets matching its color, revealed at the gate, so tickets cannot be pre-made. Extra clones queue in the canyon, each waiting a full epoch behind the last, so a fleet of n pays n seasons of tending and n epochs of waiting for one crossing while one honest agent crosses once.
